# selecting an offer fills the payment slot and awards nothing
ADV High minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV High minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
TRADER V xp=0 level=1 trading=High
# taking the result: the trade advancement and the height advancement for the player at the build limit
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade_at_world_height trade_at_world_height
ADV High minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV High minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT High minecraft.crafted:minecraft.bread 6
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.talked_to_villager 1
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.traded_with_villager 1
TRADER V xp=1 level=1 trading=High
OFFERS V count=2
OFFER V 0 buyA=minecraft:emerald*1 buyB=- sell=minecraft:bread*6 uses=1 max=12 xp=1 mult=0.05 demand=0 special=0
OFFER V 1 buyA=minecraft:emerald*2 buyB=- sell=minecraft:cookie*4 uses=0 max=9 xp=1 mult=0.05 demand=0 special=0
# a player at ground level gets the first only
ADV Low minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV Low minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV Low minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT Low minecraft.crafted:minecraft.bread 6
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 2
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.talked_to_villager 1
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 2
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 2
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 2
STAT Low minecraft.custom:minecraft.traded_with_villager 1
TRADER W xp=1 level=1 trading=Low
# a creative player trades with the wandering trader at the build limit
ADV Cre minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV Cre minecraft:adventure/trade_at_world_height trade_at_world_height
ADV Cre minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV Cre minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT Cre minecraft.crafted:minecraft.bread 6
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 2
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.talked_to_villager 1
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 2
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 2
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 2
STAT Cre minecraft.custom:minecraft.traded_with_villager 1
TRADER T xp=0 level=- trading=Cre
OFFERS T count=1
OFFER T 0 buyA=minecraft:emerald*1 buyB=- sell=minecraft:bread*6 uses=1 max=12 xp=1 mult=0.05 demand=0 special=0
# the second result of the villager and a second take award nothing new
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade_at_world_height trade_at_world_height
ADV High minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV High minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
STAT High minecraft.crafted:minecraft.bread 12
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.play_time 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.talked_to_villager 1
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_death 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.time_since_rest 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.total_world_time 2
STAT High minecraft.custom:minecraft.traded_with_villager 2
OFFERS V count=2
OFFER V 0 buyA=minecraft:emerald*1 buyB=- sell=minecraft:bread*6 uses=2 max=12 xp=1 mult=0.05 demand=0 special=0
OFFER V 1 buyA=minecraft:emerald*2 buyB=- sell=minecraft:cookie*4 uses=0 max=9 xp=1 mult=0.05 demand=0 special=0
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV High minecraft:adventure/trade_at_world_height trade_at_world_height
ADV High minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV High minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
ADV Low minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV Low minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV Low minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
ADV Cre minecraft:adventure/trade traded
ADV Cre minecraft:adventure/trade_at_world_height trade_at_world_height
ADV Cre minecraft:recipes/building_blocks/emerald_block has_emerald
ADV Cre minecraft:recipes/decorations/crafting_table unlock_right_away
